examples.ar: قُلْ بِبَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَبِرَحْمَتِهِ فَبِذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَفْرَحُوا.
examples.en: Say, 'In the bounty of God and in His mercy - in that let them rejoice.'

examples.ar: فَمَن زُحْزِحَ عَنِ النَّارِ وَأُدْخِلَ الْجَنَّةَ فَقَدْ فَازَ.
examples.en: So he who is drawn away from the Fire and admitted to Paradise has attained [his desire].

examples.ar: الفِكْرُ الحُرُّ هُوَ رَكِيزَةُ الإِبْدَاعِ الإِنْسَانِيِّ.
examples.en: Free thought is the pillar of human creativity.

examples.ar: ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ اللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَاءُ.
examples.en: That is the favor of God, He bestows it upon whom He wills.

examples.ar: اغْتَنَمَ الشَّابُّ فُرْصَةَ السَّفَرِ لِتَعَلُّمِ مَهَارَاتٍ نَادِرَةٍ.
examples.en: The young man seized the travel opportunity to learn rare skills.
Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.

examples.ar: تَدْرُسُ الفَلْسَفَةُ العَلَاقَةَ بَيْنَ العَقْلِ وَالوَاقِعِ.
examples.en: Philosophy studies the relationship between mind and reality.
